title: Deals: the iPhone 18 Pros are now available, but iPhone 17 Pro and Galaxy S26 models are cheaper
description: The iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max went on sale this week in Germany, along with 64 other countries in the first wave. If you have your eyes set on an iPhone Duo, you will have to wait for over a month more to get it. As for the new Pro models, here is a reminder of their prices – the small iPhone 18 Pro starts at €1,450, while the larger iPhone 18 Pro Max starts at €1,600. As is tradition, Apple stopped selling the old Pros when the new ones were unveiled – only non-Pro models last more than a year on Apple.com. But that doesn’t stop third-party retailers from selling older Pros as you’ll...

title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro in for review
description: It's that time of year again - the new iPhone generation is upon us, and while the foldable iPhone Duo stole the spotlight this year, the iPhone 18 Pro series is still hard to ignore. So while we are waiting on the iPhone Duo to arrive, we are kickstarting the iPhone 18 Pro review process. iPhone 18 Pro vs. 18 Pro Max Aside from the new hero Burgundy color, the 18 Pro also comes in Glacier, Black and Silver colorways. The one we have right here is the Glacier paint job. A subtle change to the appearance is the smaller Dynamic Island, which can now display up to three live...

title: The new itel A300C is tough, cheap and has a 6,000mAh battery
description: itel spent weeks teasing its new A300C model and it is finally go time. This is a rugged-but-affordable Android 16 Go Edition phone – it costs ₹11,000 and comes with 4GB of RAM and 64GB of storage. That isn’t much, of course, but the phone supports microSD cards up to 2TB, so you can add as much storage as you like. The phone has a MIL-STD-810H certification (it has been drop tested). However, it lacks an official dust and water resistance rating. On the plus side, itel offers a free screen replacement for the first 100 days after you buy the phone. The itel A300C has a 6.56” 90Hz...

title: This is when Motorola is unveiling the Signature 27
description: Motorola's Signature, its current flagship smartphone, came out in January, and now the company is almost ready to reveal its successor, the Signature 27. Motorola started teasing the upcoming device earlier this month, and today it has announced its unveiling date: September 22. That is also when Qualcomm is expected to unveil the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 and the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro chipsets, during its Snapdragon Summit in Hawaii. Motorola specifically calls out the Snapdragon Summit, so it looks like the Signature 27 using one of those chips is a given. There’s more to...

title: First iPhone 18 Pro teardown video is here
description: The iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max have been released today, and there's already a teardown video of the former available on YouTube. Undoubtedly, many more will follow, but if you've been very anxiously waiting to take a peek inside the new iPhone 18 Pro, here's your first chance to do so below (beware the AI voice though). The teardown starts with the pentalobe screws on the bottom, then heat, a suction cup, and alcohol are used to remove the display. title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max in for review
description: The iPhone 18 Pro Max could very well have been called the 17S Pro Max. It brings a chip update, some minor tweaks to the camera and new colors. Back in the day that basically amounted to an S-series update but Apple insists on a whole number update and in the midst of the global memory chip shortage is asking $100/€150/£100 more than last year's 17 Pro Max. There’s not much to talk about in terms of the unboxing experience. You still get a USB-C cable, which is … nice. At this point we’re not sure how many future iPhones will launch with bundled accessories, so a cable is better than...

title: Apple, Samsung and Google face potential device ban in the US
description: A new investigation by the US International Trade Commission (USITC) over spatial audio patent infringement could result in bans for Apple, Samsung and Google devices in the US. BoomCloud 360 is a relatively small audio company based in California which focuses on cloud sound optimization software for movies, games and music. It also holds valuable patents in the domain of spatial audio, which have been the subject of the ongoing probe. The original complaint was filed back in August and includes three patent disputes which BoomCloud 360 claims are being infringed upon by devices...

title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro and S27 Ultra's battery capacities and charging specs revealed
description: Samsung's upcoming Galaxy S27 Pro and Galaxy S27 Ultra have just been certified for sale in China by 3C. This has revealed the fact that they both support 60W wired charging, just like this year's Galaxy S26 Ultra. Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro and S27 Ultra charging specs But while there's no change there, there is an exciting one in the battery capacity department. The 3C has also seemingly certified the duo's batteries, and the S27 Ultra's is rated at 5,534 mAh. That will most likely result in a typical advertised capacity of 5,700 mAh - 700 mAh more than what its predecessor can...

title: vivo X500 Pro Max's main specs are out just as it receives another certification
description: vivo is unveiling the X500 family on September 21, and ahead of that, today the main specs of the leader of the pack, the X500 Pro Max, have been outed. The X500 Pro Max has a 6.85-inch flat LTPO OLED screen with a 144Hz refresh rate and ultra-thin bezels, the Dimensity 9600 Pro SoC at the helm, and a 7,000 mAh battery with support for 90W wired charging, as well as unspecified wireless charging. description: OnePlus has started teasing the upcoming OnePlus 16 a few days ago, confirming its 165Hz global refresh rate screen. Today, a new leak from the prolific Digital Chat Station on Weibo reveals the device's main specs in full. It will be powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro chipset. The refresh rate will actually climb up to 185Hz in specific games. The phone will have a 9,000 mAh battery with support for 100W wired and 50W wireless charging. title: Oppo K14 lineup is getting a new Plus variant in India
description: The Oppo K14 series is set to get another member in India. Following the recent launch of the K14 Lite, the company has now started teasing a new K14 Plus variant. The lineup also includes the K14 and K14x. Oppo has teased the launch of the new smartphone on social media, although the company has not revealed many details yet. The teaser image does suggest that the K14 Plus will be available in at least Orange and Gray colorways. The phone also appears to feature a flat frame. title: Lava Bold N4 Pro is official with a 6,000 mAh battery, here's when it goes on sale
description: Lava launched the Bold N4 Lite in late August, and very soon it will be joined by the Bold N4 Pro in the company's lineup in India. Ahead of its launch, a special microsite on Amazon has revealed all of its specs, as well as the launch date and price, so buckle in and let's take a look. The Lava Bold N4 Pro has a 6.75-inch 720x1612 LCD touchscreen with a 120Hz refresh rate and 550-nit peak brightness. It's powered by the Unisoc T8200 SoC paired with 6GB of LPDDR4X RAM and 128GB of UFS 2.2 storage, which is expandable via a microSD card. The phone has a 50MP main camera, an 8MP...

title: Android-powered Arc X1 gaming handheld launches with 7-inch display, Snapdragon G2 Gen 2
description: India-based gaming company Arc has introduced its first gaming handheld, the Arc X1. The device is powered by Qualcomm’s Snapdragon G2 Gen 2 chipset and runs OwlOS, a custom Android based operating system developed specifically for the handheld. The Snapdragon G2 Gen 2 chipset is paired with 8GB of LPDDR5X RAM and 128GB of UFS 3.1 internal storage. The handheld also features a microSD card slot for storage expansion. title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro series goes on sale
description: Following their announcement last week and a subsequent six-day pre-order campaign, the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max are now available for purchase across the first wave of 65 countries. The list includes Australia, Canada, China, Colombia, France, Germany, India, Japan, Malaysia, Mexico, Singapore, South Korea, Thailand, Turkey, the UAE, the UK, the US, and Vietnam, amongst others. Another 20 countries will get the new iPhone models from September 25. Apple iPhone 18 Pro • Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max Users who placed their orders should be getting their devices starting today....

title: Honor X9e Pro is coming next week with an 11,000mAh battery
description: Honor is gearing up to launch the X9e Pro in Malaysia and has been teasing the device on social media. The phone is set to launch next week, but several details about the handset have already surfaced online ahead of the unveiling. The Honor X9e Pro will launch in Malaysia on September 24, according to the official Honor Malaysia website. It will be available in Dawn Gold, Midnight Black, Reddish Brown, and Royal Purple colorways. title: Honor 700 Pro to have a rear screen
description: Xiaomi's 17 Pro and 17 Pro Max popularized the rear screen idea last year, and the company is getting ready to launch their successors later this month. Meanwhile, Honor has apparently been inspired by Xiaomi, and it's now working on at least one device with a rear screen of its own. This will be part of the Honor 700 series, according to a new rumor from Digital Chat Station on Weibo. title: It's now the Xiaomi 18 Pro Max's turn to surface in Geekbench
description: Yesterday, the upcoming Xiaomi 18 Pro was seemingly spotted in the Geekbench online database, and today it's the turn of its bigger sibling, the Xiaomi 18 Pro Max, to surface in the same place. This one allegedly has the model number M610BB. As you can see in the screenshot below, it managed a single-core score of 2,831 and a multi-core score of 8,843 in Geekbench 7 for Android. As always, we caution you against taking such numbers too seriously, as they are results from pre-production prototypes. description: The new Pixel 11 series is now out so new and returning customers have started making their comparisons. And we are doing our best to help with a more detailed look at the most popular ones. Pixel 11 Pro or Pixel 10 Pro? Let’s find out! The 256GB base version of the Google Pixel 11 Pro is quite pricey at €1,100, while the 128GB base model of the Google Pixel 10 Pro now sits at a far more reasonable price of €770. title: Samsung to outsource all of its DRAM manufacturing and focus on HBM production
description: The AI race is heating up, and so is the demand for hardware required to support it. That's why companies that produce HBM memory chips like Samsung have benefited immensely in the last few years. So it's only logical for Samsung to shift its focus to HBM memory production, as this is the company's best-performing business lately. According to inside sources, Samsung is already in talks with its partners, urging them to finish their DDR5 production lines ahead of schedule and is looking to invest in new outsourced production lines as well. title: iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max pre-orders in China eclipse the 2025 Pros
description: Pre-orders in the US may have been less than stellar, but the new iPhone 18 Pro models are a huge hit in China. Local publications report that a total of over 7 million units have been pre-ordered across all channels. Pre-orders for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max started late in the evening of September 12 (Saturday) at 8pm. Retailer JD ran out of available units in under a minute. We don’t know how many units JD had on hand, but there are similar stories from other retailers.
